text: But Aziz is still at level one, and his orders are personal data.

text: In Lesson 21, the token carried the session level, one or two.

text: This lesson shows what an app does when that level is too low: the required level of each app, the step-up, and the trip to the master app.
prefix: This lesson shows what an app does when that level is too low: the required level of each app, the step-up, and the trip to the master app.

text: Start with the apps themselves.
prefix: Start with the apps themselves.

text: Each app of the bank is written in the installation with a name, a kind and a required level.
prefix: Each app of the bank is written in the installation with a name, a kind and a required level.

text: The mobile bank is one app.
prefix: The mobile bank is one app.

text: The marketplace app is another, and the marketplace web profile is a third.
prefix: The marketplace app is another, and the marketplace web profile is a third.

text: The credit service is one more.
prefix: The credit service is one more.

text: The bank sets the required level of each app.
prefix: The bank sets the required level of each app.

text: In fact, the installation will not start until at least one app has a required level.
prefix: In fact, the installation will not start until at least one app has a required level.

text: An app with required level one is usable right after registration.
prefix: An app with required level one is usable right after registration.

text: Aziz registered, set his password, and could browse the marketplace at once.
prefix: Aziz registered, set his password, and could browse the marketplace at once.

text: Now the rule that changes everything for an app team.
prefix: Now the rule that changes everything for an app team.

text: Each app must ask for level two before it shows personal data: orders, addresses or cards.
prefix: Each app must ask for level two before it shows personal data: orders, addresses or cards.

text: The app does not guess the level.
prefix: The app does not guess the level.

text: It reads it from the identity summary, or straight from the token.
prefix: It reads it from the identity summary, or straight from the token.

text: So the marketplace sees level one, and My orders needs level two.
prefix: So the marketplace sees level one, and My orders needs level two.

text: Here is the part I think most teams get wrong.
prefix: Here is the part I think most teams get wrong.

text: The easy answer is to refuse, with an error and a sad face.
prefix: The easy answer is to refuse, with an error and a sad face.

text: heeyID never refuses a customer here.
prefix: heeyID never refuses a customer here.

text: Instead, the marketplace calls the step-up.
prefix: Instead, the marketplace calls the step-up.

text: The answer has three parts.
prefix: The answer has three parts.

text: The current level: one.
prefix: The current level: one.

text: The required level: two.
prefix: The required level: two.

text: And the checks that give level two: consent, a full proofing with MyID, and a phone check.
prefix: And the checks that give level two: consent, a full proofing with MyID, and a phone check.

text: So the answer is not no.
prefix: So the answer is not no.

text: It is the way up.
prefix: It is the way up.

text: But the marketplace is a side app.
prefix: But the marketplace is a side app.

text: It has no MyID inside, and it never checks a face.
prefix: It has no MyID inside, and it never checks a face.

text: So the step-up answer also says: continue in the mobile bank.
prefix: So the step-up answer also says: continue in the mobile bank.

text: If a side app tries to open a proofing anyway, the platform refuses that request.
prefix: If a side app tries to open a proofing anyway, the platform refuses that request.

text: MyID runs only in the master app, because only the master app moves money and carries the strongest protection.
prefix: MyID runs only in the master app, because only the master app moves money and carries the strongest protection.

text: The marketplace shows Aziz one button: continue in the mobile bank.
prefix: The marketplace shows Aziz one button: continue in the mobile bank.

text: He taps it, and the mobile bank opens.
prefix: He taps it, and the mobile bank opens.

text: Now the checks run, one by one, and you have seen each of them already.
prefix: Now the checks run, one by one, and you have seen each of them already.

text: First, the consent screen, from Lesson 14.
prefix: First, the consent screen, from Lesson 14.

text: Aziz reads it and accepts.

text: Then MyID, from Lesson 15: his face and his passport.

prefix: Then the phone check, from Lesson 18: his number against the numbers that MyID knows.

text: Everything matches, and his status becomes Confirmed.

text: Three things change at once.

text: Aziz is now at level two.
prefix: Aziz is now at level two.

text: His phone becomes Trusted.
prefix: His phone becomes Trusted.

text: And the gateway issues a new mobile bank token with level two.
prefix: And the gateway issues a new mobile bank token with level two.

text: Notice what did not happen.
prefix: Notice what did not happen.

text: No app gave Aziz level two.
prefix: No app gave Aziz level two.

text: No approval gave it, and no operator gave it.
prefix: No approval gave it, and no operator gave it.

text: Only the MyID check gives level two.
prefix: Only the MyID check gives level two.

text: That is a hard rule of the platform.
prefix: That is a hard rule of the platform.

text: The level belongs to the person, so it is the same in every app.
prefix: The level belongs to the person, so it is the same in every app.

text: But a session has its own level, and that is a different thing.
prefix: But a session has its own level, and that is a different thing.

text: In the mobile bank, a session has level two only on a trusted device.
prefix: In the mobile bank, a session has level two only on a trusted device.

prefix: If Aziz opens the mobile bank on a different phone, that session starts at level one.

text: In a side app, a session gets level two only after Aziz approves it in the master app.
prefix: In a side app, a session gets level two only after Aziz approves it in the master app.

text: So back in the marketplace, the person is at level two, and the marketplace session reaches level two through that approval.

text: I think this is a good design.
prefix: I think this is a good design.

text: The person proves who he is once, in one strong place.

text: Every other app borrows that proof, and never copies it.

prefix: Each app has a required level.
